messages:
Sam (AM): Heads-up — Nimbus POC stalled on observability handoff. Logs arrive but their APM doesn't join spans; Splunk drain returning mixed 403/429.
Rina (SE): Can you paste one raw log line + a sample trace id? is the trace in header or body?
Sam (AM): Example log: 2026-04-02T11:02:05Z lvl=info msg="resp done" route=/chat trace=9f8e7d6c user=nimbus-7
Trace is in body as "trace=9f8e7d6c". Their APM looks for header X-NIMBUS-TRACE.
Rina (SE): Our collector forwards x-request-id, traceparent and b3. Edge strips unknown custom headers unless enabled per-tenant. @Luca any quick toggle?
Luca (SRE): We have a tenant header whitelist feature. I can enable whitelist for nimbus-7 and add a mapping to inject X-NIMBUS-TRACE copied from the log field. Low risk.
logs-bot: Drain job 5801 -> FAILED (403) to https://ingest.nimbus.splunk:8088 (attempt 2)
reason: auth header rewritten by customer proxy
Maya (Eng): Our drain sends Authorization: Splunk <token>. If their proxy rewrites Authorization, they can accept X-Splunk-Token; we can send that header instead per-tenant.
Sam (AM): Nimbus confirmed they can accept X-Splunk-Token and will map X-NIMBUS-TRACE to spans, but asked us to inject X-NIMBUS-TRACE to be safe.
Luca (SRE): I'll enable header whitelist and mapping now, and temporarily raise drain rate_limit to 50/s for 24h to validate. Rolling in ~8 minutes.
logs-bot: Drain job 5802 -> SUCCESS to datadog-forwarder (latency 148ms)
Rina (SE): I'll post curl snippets to #sales after the deploy:
curl -v -H "Authorization: Splunk <their-token>" -H "X-Request-ID: 42" https://ingest.nimbus.splunk:8088/services/collector/event/1.0
or use X-Splunk-Token header if proxy rewrites Authorization.
Sam (AM): Security Q: Nimbus asked if we support their KMS for log encryption in Private.
Maya (Eng): Yes for Private we support customer-managed KMS/HSM; for Hosted we have BYOK options for sensitive fields. I'll add standard SOC2/KMS wording to the questionnaire.
Sam (AM): Next steps: Luca to apply header mapping + rate bump; Maya to update questionnaire + retention trial; Rina to share curl examples; Sam to run validation call 2026-04-02 15:00 UTC. Keeping thread live.
